{{Quote|The Republic never had its own navy until the Clone Wars. It always depended on the home fleets to supply what was necessary.|[[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="Republic 70">[[Republic 70|''Republic'' 70]]</ref>}}
The '''Republic Navy''' or '''Republic fleet''', once known as the '''Navy of the Republic''',<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> was the military fleet used to defend the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout many millennia.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic Navy was also known as the '''GAR Fleet''' due to its connection to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

==History==
===The First Navy and Re-Establishment===
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was founded in [[25,053 BBY]], it was founded without a standing navy, for fear that the military will become a tool of powerful Core worlds and their interests. It was not until [[24,000 BBY]], when the [[Tionese War]] against the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] began, that a centralized navy was created; the Republic's member worlds had relied on their own militaries and were expected to contribute resources and troops to a centralized force if a threat presented itself. According to navy tradition, the Republic Navy was headquartered on [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], the site of the Republic's largest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], but it was disbanded at the war's end around [[23,900 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" /> During the Tionese War, the cruiser-sized ''[[Gilagimar]]'' was active, and it was one of the most famous vessels from the Navy during the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]].<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="Warfare" />

During the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of seventeen wars between the Republic and the allies of the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] resisted calls for the Navy's reinstatement. In the early conflicts, both Alsakan and the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]-controlled Republic attempted to use massive battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] to secure victories, but neither side had the military resources to split their forces between attack and defense. During the [[Duinuogwuin Contention]] of [[15,500 BBY]], when the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] attacked the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Coruscant, further calls for the Navy's return were blocked by internal feuding in the Senate. Around 15,000 BBY, however, the Senate finally heeded the pleas of the outlying systems and re-established the Navy<ref name="Warfare" /> with its headquarters on Coruscant.<ref name="KOTOR CG" />

===The Pius Dea===
In the subsequent Alsakan Conflicts, both the Navy and Alsakan began to use their larger battleships to guard their planets in the Core while smaller and faster cruisers raided and protected colonies in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The Conflicts grew less and less brutal over the centuries, as all of them ended in ceasefires and most consisted only of raiding of colonies.<ref name="Warfare" /> During the first few centuries of the Navy's existence, they fought battles at planets such as [[Esaga]], [[Caulbon]], and [[The Sundered Veil/Legends|the Sundered Veil]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], and the Navy's ships defended the Republic's colonies and fought back against the [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] who plagued the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Warfare" />

In [[11,987 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], beginning the period known as the [[Pius Dea Era]]. Contispex was a high-ranking member of the [[Pius Dea]] religion, and his ascension to the head of the Republic soon brought Pius Dea adherents into most of the government's positions of power. In [[11,965 BBY]], Contispex launched the [[First Pius Dea Crusade]], a military crusade against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and the Republic Navy's forces launched along the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] route and from the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Ord Yndar]] and [[Ord Wylan]] against the western edge of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Under Contispex's descendants and successors in the [[Contispex dynasty]] of Chancellors, the Republic would launch a total of thirty-four [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and the Navy became a stronghold of Pius Dea influence during their reign.<ref name="Warfare" />

The Republic Military converted at blasterpoint thousands of people in the Mid Rim and the Outer Rim, and though defeated populations could retain autonomy if they converted, only those who joined the Republic Navy could move freely between planets. By the [[11,500 BBY|11,500s BBY]], Pius Dea [[cathedral ship]]s made up a large part of the Navy, crewed by descendants of the original naval crews and commanded by missionaries. Under the Pius Dea, the Navy also established a large number of [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]] along the frontier of the Republic, planets that served as home bases from which the Pius Dea and the Navy could push forward into the "alien chaos" of the Outer Rim. The Navy plundered many of the worlds that they discovered on their crusades, descending upon those worlds found to be impure and deploying millions of troops to purge the inhabitants and claim their riches. The [[bi-wing snub fighter]] saw use in the Republic Navy during this [[Time/Legends|time]], as did the [[Man-of-war/Legends|man-of-war]].<ref name="Warfare" />

===The Sith Wars===
{{Quote|I'm just a soldier; I go where the fleet Admirals tell me to. I follow my orders and I do my duty.|Carth Onasi|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Republicfleetkotor2.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Republic Navy during the time of the Jedi Civil War.]]
For 4,000 years, the Republic Navy also worked almost side by side with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in repelling attacks from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] and other aggressors.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> The mandate of the Republic Navy allowed them to move into designated star systems in order to deal with any unrest that had formed with the knowledge that the majority of the governments of the Galactic Republic supported these actions. Any planetary government could call upon the Navy's help, although it would need [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] approval if the action was to last longer than seven [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard days]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Individual [[Senator/Legends|senators]] also often commandeered Navy groups for their own benefit.

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the technological ancestors of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] would be manufactured, such as the [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]] and the [[Centurion-class battlecruiser/Legends|''Centurion''-class battlecruiser]]. Later, during the [[Jedi Civil War]], the Republic had to rely on smaller ships such as the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]].<ref name="KOTOR CG" /> Following the fragmentation of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Revan's Sith Empire]] and the subsequent [[Dark Wars]], the Republic rebuilt its Navy in just over a year and launched a counteroffensive; through strategic leadership, it gradually defeated individual Sith warlords and reclaimed lost territories, returning to nearly full strength by the time the Sith were eradicated.<ref name="KOTOR CG" /> Centuries following this event, the Republic fleet suffered heavy casualties from the onslaught of the newly reborn Sith Empire. Despite losing many worlds in the initial stages of the [[Great Galactic War]], the navy was responsible for the Republic's first major victory at the [[First Battle of Bothawui]] where fleet warships destroyed a Sith squadron of warships that intended to invade [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. After the [[New Sith Wars]], the Republic scaled down the Navy as part of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], and placed it under the control of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. Its priorities were shifted from full-scale conflict to sector-scale and system-scale patrol, anti-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] operations, and exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="NEC" />

===Reformed and Clone Wars===
During the final years of the Republic, a [[Militarists/Legends|Militarist]] faction attempted to reform the Republic Navy and [[Republic Army|Army]], but progress was slow. The [[Katana fleet]] was the first attempt by the Republic to make a functioning armada for the Navy, but it was soon lost.<ref name="TEC" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] tried to portray the space forces of [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|his fleet]] as the legitimate Republic Navy, even referring to it as such.<ref name="TSHW">''[[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War]]''</ref>

[[File:Spacebattle.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] at the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
Decades later, a restored Republic Navy operated alongside the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It absorbed the local member world defense fleets into the consolidated Navy following the [[Battle of Rendili]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Until the passage of the [[Security Act amendment]] shortly before the war's end, the Navy was under the joint command of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]; afterwards, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] served as its sole commanding authority.<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed, the Republic Navy became the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Planetary Naval Forces==
[[File:Rendilihomefleet.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Five ships of the [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet|Home Defense Fleet]].]]

The Galactic Republic Navy, while having a standing military force throughout the galaxy, did include many volunteer and planetary forces. The rich and heavily industrialized [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] like [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], and [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] built fleets centered around powerful multi-kilometer long warships.<ref name="TFNCi">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/jedicouncil/interview/saxton.asp|text=TFN Curtis Saxton interview|archivedate=20041212113642}}</ref><ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> However, due to their limited [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] these large warships were designed to only defend their respective local [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. The robust planetary and sector fleets of the Core Worlds not only assisted in defending their own planets against pirate raids and crime lords, but were also relied upon to provide sufficient firepower to defend the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] from invasion.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> This was evident during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] when a [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian]] fleet launched a major counteroffensive along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] against [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces.<ref name="Atlas" /> Fleets from planets and sectors such as Kuat, Humbarine, and [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] would also take part in the fighting during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. These planetary and sector [[Navy/Legends|navies]] were headed up by the [[Admiral of the Coreworlds|Admirals of the Coreworlds]], whose authority was recognized only within in their respective sectors. Meanwhile, [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] sectors usually operated a large amount of smaller and less powerful vessels.<ref name="TFNCi" /> Some of these planetary forces include:

*[[Chandrila Defense Fleet]]
*[[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]]
*[[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]]
*[[Freeworlds Common Navy]]
*[[Planetary Security Forces|Humbarine Sector defense forces]]
*[[Kuati Sector Forces]]
*[[Onderonian Space Force|Onderonian navy]]
*[[Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet/Legends|Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet]]
*[[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]]

==Organization==
{{Quote|The galaxy will run out of stars to visit before the Navy runs out of Lieutenants.|Aphmorism over Lieutenants during the Restoration period|<ref name="KOTOR CG" />}}
Oversight over the Republic Navy was handled by the [[Naval Subcommittee/Legends|Senate Naval Subcommittee]] whilst appropriations were dealt with by its [[Procurement Panel/Legends|Procurement Panel of the Senate Naval Subcommittee]].

===Mandalorian Wars/Jedi Civil War===
Overall command of the Republic Navy was given to the [[Admiral of the Fleet/Legends|Admiral of the Fleet]], a political position chosen by the Defense Ministry from among the ranks of full [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]]. Charged with command of the millions of beings and trillions of tons of deadly force, it was a prestigious position for which many high-ranking officers jockeyed to attain.<ref name="KOTOR CG" />

Below the Admiral of the Fleet were the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] navies, each commanded by an [[Admiral of the Coreworlds]]. While technically in command of any ships within their sector of operation, this authority was rarely exercised except in cases of meddling in local politics. Such a position rarely saw action, and was usually the providence of elderly Admirals with no interest in commanding on the battlefront or positioning themselves to become the next Admiral of the Fleet.<ref name="KOTOR CG" />

Below them were the various [[Fleet/Legends|Fleets]] commanded by Admirals, [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admirals]] and [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admirals]]. There was no set size for each fleet, with each admiral given command of a number of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] along the battlefront with the authority to make broad strategic decisions. [[Captain/Legends|Captains]] were given command of individual capital ships, although smaller vessels were sometimes captained by [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]].<ref name="KOTOR CG" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|The Senate has agreed that all home defense fleets must now become part of the Republic Navy. That's what we must do&mdash;''centralize'' our forces.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Republic 71">[[Republic 71|''Republic'' 71]]</ref>}}
[[File:RepublicInvasionForce-LaPR.png|thumb|right|250px|Part of the Open Circle Fleet]]

During the Clone Wars, the Republic Navy was divided into multiple fleets, each fleet representing the sum total of naval forces in a given sector. Each fleet varied in composition, in relation to the needs of their assigned battlespace, and could be combined to form provisional task forces as needed. Most officers, especially high-ranking officers, were not clones. They came either from the navies of various [[Planetary Security Forces|Sector Forces]] or from the ranks of the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Fleet]].<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The command structure of the Republic Navy was further broken down as follows:

'''Republic Navy''': Consisting of hundreds of fleets, the Navy was under the leadership of [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] after the passage of the Security Act amendment.<ref name="CWCG" />

'''Armada''': An Armada was an administrative formation representing all forces allocated to a specific theater of war, generally numbering between 1,000 to 5,000 warships plus support units. It was commanded by a [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]], such as a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="CWCG" />

'''Fleet''': A Fleet was commanded by a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]]. It was generally composed of 3 to 6 Battle Groups numbering between 100 to 300 warships plus support units.<ref name="CWCG" />

'''Battle Group''': A Battle Group was commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] or [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and consisted of 2 to 4 Squadrons. Numbering between 48 to 72 warships plus support units, a Battle Group was considered to have enough force to take all but the most heavily fortified enemy strongholds.<ref name="CWCG" />

'''Squadron''': A Squadron was commanded by a [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] or Jedi General and consisted of 3 to 4 Sections, or roughly 12 to 36 warships, plus support units. Each Section was meant to compliment each other, such as a group of escorts providing a defensive screen for larger warships.<ref name="CWCG" />

'''Section''': A Section was usually commanded by the most senior [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], unless there was a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] present. The exact role of a Section determined how many ships it contained. Large warships, such as battleships and cruisers, operated in "lines" of 3 to 4 vessels. Smaller craft, such as corvettes, operated in "flotillas" of 6 to 12 vessels.<ref name="CWCG" />

'''Element''': The technical name given to a single ship, each ship was normally commanded by a Captain. Rarely was a Jedi Commander given command of a ship.<ref name="CWCG" />

===Naval Starfighter Corps===
Though there was a [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|separate starfighter corps]], the navy also maintained its own squadrons of starfighters onboard each warship. These fighters were meant for ship-to-ship combat as well as space fights. Although not named, [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone Pilots]] operated under this same concept.

===Marines===
{{Main|Clone marine}}

Marines were the ship-to-ship assault and defense soldiers of the navy. Originally birth-born recruits and [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] they used specially trained [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as marines to counter the [[droid marine]]s of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. They were most likely the basis for the [[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]]. 

===Personnel===
Personnel of the Republic Navy were drawn from a mixture of commissioned officers, non-commissioned crew, and specialists. Officers were primarily trained at the Coruscant [[Naval Academy]], with additional instruction provided by satellite institutions. The Corellian Academy produced many of the Navy’s shipwrights and engineers, while a Duros orbital facility was noted for its focus on tactical networking. The majority of personnel serving aboard naval vessels or in shipyards were non-commissioned crew members, typically recruited through local enlistment centers. During periods of Sith threat, signing bonuses were occasionally offered, though the Navy’s prestige generally made compulsory service unnecessary. On rare occasions, experienced merchant captains were granted provisional ratings to serve on naval bridges in wartime, though these appointments were often rescinded in peacetime, which sometimes created tension with civilian spacer communities.<ref name="KOTOR CG" />
